rdf:Description.dc:title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial, Three Soldiers
rdf:Description.dc:description: The Three Soldiers statue sits a few feet from the Vietnam Veterans Memorial Wall. This statue was added after the Wall opened to complement it and to offer an alternative memorial for critics who disliked the non-traditional design of the Wall. The sculpture's 3 soldiers represent the diversity of the US military by including a Caucasian, African American, and Latino American whose service branch is intentionally ambiguous. Together, they face the Wall of the fallen.
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Frederick Hart
